messages:
Priya N: hey team, Priya here — first day in CS! :wave: quick list so I can be productive: HubSpot (prod), Aircall seat, Gong access for call review, the CS playbook, and the objection-handling cheat. who should I ping for each?
Oliver (IT): welcome Priya! I can kick HubSpot and Aircall. Sent HubSpot invite to priya@redwood — will require Okta MFA. Aircall seat request submitted, expect an email from aircall@notifications with a one-time link.
Sasha (sales-ops): hi Priya :tada: canonical playbook is in /playbooks/cs named "cs_funnel_v6_master". Objection cheat is "OBJECTION_BRIEF_CS_v3" in /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets. I'll add you to the folder and DM links.
Nate (CS): i'll add you to Gong and flag 3 calls to listen to (onboarding, renewal, escalation). also let's schedule a 30-min playbook walkthrough once your tools are up.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Complete the "Sales/CS Tools" checklist within 48 hours to keep seats active: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs
Priya N: got HubSpot and set up MFA. Aircall link pending. also saw two playbook copies — which one is the live version?
Sasha (sales-ops): use cs_funnel_v6_master for live scripts. older files end with _ARCHIVE. I'll pin a note in the folder.
Oliver (IT): resent Aircall invite. If you hit the setup error, try the web app. If that fails, tell me your OS/browser.
Priya N: Aircall arrived, joined and configured headset. thanks all! who owns the CS templates for outbound macros?
Sasha (sales-ops): I manage macros — template name is `cs_templates_v2` in Notion. I'll share edit access. Welcome aboard! :rocket:
